items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Who did you have? Gerry Mulligan, the Superstars, at that time that boy played the trumpet.

ctx.x: I have to talk about the laymen men because he's the man that takes care of us, you know. So these writers started writing about these freedom players, you see. And yeah, I do believe that it was a conspiracy and that because in order for the white musician to get a play, they had to get all these people off the scene man because there wasn't too much places for white musicians to play. Who did you have? Gerry Mulligan, the Superstars, at that time that boy played the trumpet.
